narr: A warm and unstable environment south of a warm front supported the development of scattered thunderstorms over northeastern Pennsylvania. Torrential rainfall contributed to localized flooding of small streams, creeks and area roads.
ev: Basements are flooding on Sterling Road in the Town of Sterling.
Interstate 84 Eastbound was shutdown due to flooding with multiple cars stuck in the water.
The intersection of Route 191 and Route 196 was washed out.
